<thought>Using the high‑resolution mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 114.06808. This matches a sodium adduct ([M+Na]⁺) of a neutral molecule with monoisotopic mass ≈ 91.0759 Da. The formula C₄H₁₁O₂ has an exact monoisotopic mass of 91.07590 Da, and adding Na (22.98977 Da) gives 114.06567 Da, which is within the experimental error of the observed m/z. Therefore the molecular formula of the sample compound is C₄H₁₁O₂.</thought>
<final_answer>C4H11O2</final_answer>
